changelog: 🎙️ Live Voice Interaction in Personal Assistant Mode: Start hands-free, continuous spoken calls with your personal assistant featuring on-device speech recognition, neural voice synthesis, audio visualizer, barge-in interruption, and live captions directly from the assistant orb and panel.

✨ Customizable Personal Assistant: Renamed settings to 'Personal Assistant' with custom assistant name personalization (e.g. Jarvis, Friday, Nova, AntiBot), dynamically reflected in prompts, wake words, and UI.
🌐 Universal Live Voice Call Screen: Live voice calls are now globally accessible across all tabs, IDE, terminal, browser, and personal assistant modes.
